# routeros_system_package_local_update_mirror (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_package_local_update_mirror" "mirror" {
  check_interval = "10s"
  enabled        = true
  password       = "changeme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `check_interval` (String) The time interval at which the device checks the local package server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the periodic check of the local package server is enabled.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password that is used to access the local package server.
- `primary_server` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the primary local package server.
- `secondary_server` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the secondary local package server.
- `user` (String) The user name that is used to access the local package server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `software_id` (String) The software ID of this device.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/system/package/local-update/mirror get [print show-ids]]
```
